theme.dashboard: Light Theme (ARCHETYPE 4: SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST). Goal: Data density, clarity, functional beauty for fast management.
theme.public_page: Dark Theme (ARCHETYPE 5: LUXURY). Goal: High visual impact, trust, emotional connection for high conversion.

typography.strategy: The 'Old Money Tech' (SaaS/Fintech) - Serif for public elegance, clean sans for dashboard utility.

fonts.public_headings: Playfair Display, Cormorant Garamond, or Spectral
fonts.public_body: Figtree, Inter, or IBM Plex Sans
fonts.dashboard_headings: Cabinet Grotesk, Satoshi, or IBM Plex Sans
fonts.dashboard_body: IBM Plex Sans, Inter, or Figtree

public.surface: GLASSMORPHISM (The 'Crystal' Variant). Use backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 with 1px border-white/10. Add backdrop-saturate-150.
public.overlays: Hero images must have bg-black/50 or bg-black/60. Never pure transparent.

dashboard.surface: GRID BORDERS (The 'Technical' Look). Flat solid backgrounds. 1px subtle borders (border-border). No heavy shadows on default state.
dashboard.hover: -translate-y-1 with subtle shadow-md and explicit text color change.

layouts_and_grids.dashboard_timeline: Horizontal scrollable grid. Left fixed column: Tables. Top fixed row: Time (e.g., 12:00, 13:00). Grid cells represent time slots. Reservations are blocks overlaid with absolute positioning or subgrid spanning.
layouts_and_grids.public_wizard: Bento Grid (Mode A) inspired wrapper. Centered massive glassmorphism card covering 80vh max. Mobile: padding p-4, Desktop: p-12.
layouts_and_grids.general_spacing: Generous Spacing. Use p-6 to p-12 inside containers to prevent text collision and maintain breathing room.

components_strategy.dashboard: Shadcn UI heavily customized. Go cardless or rectangular dense styles for the timeline/list. Use Shadcn Calendar, Select, Dialog for new bookings.
components_strategy.public: Raw HTML + Tailwind for structure. Use Shadcn only for complex interactions (Datepicker). Buttons should be pill-shaped or sharp with clear hover interactions.
components_strategy.badges: Status badges must use distinct colors, rounded-full, text-xs font-semibold px-2.5 py-0.5.

motion.wizard_transitions: Use framer-motion for step transitions (fade in, slide up). Ensure smooth progressive disclosure.
motion.micro_interactions: Hover states on all buttons (scale, color shift). Focus rings on all inputs.

accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='submit-booking').
accessibility.contrast: Text over images needs text-shadow or dark overlay. Maintain minimum APCA contrast ratios.
accessibility.focus: Clear focus rings on interactive elements (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:outline-none).

public_wizard_bg.description: Luxurious upscale dining room. Use as fixed background behind the public booking wizard.

wizard_step_visual_1.description: Chef pouring sauce. Good for visual split screens in the wizard steps.

wizard_step_visual_2.description: Dining room table with wine glasses. Use for confirmation/success screen.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the dashboard (staff view) and public wizard (customer view) as separate conceptual areas (e.g., /dashboard... and /book/:restaurant).
Implement real-time polling every 5 seconds for dashboard data (using custom hooks with setInterval).
Develop multi-language support (IT/EN) with a UI toggle accessible in both Dashboard and Public Wizard.
Dashboard Timeline: Implement as a horizontal grid. Tables are rows, time chunks are columns. Blocks color-coded by status (Pending, Accepted, Seated, Declined, No-Show, Cancelled).
Public Wizard: 4 steps - 1. Party Size, 2. Date (Calendar), 3. Time Slots, 4. Contact Details. Use Framer Motion for smooth transitions between steps.
Include Reports view with a bar chart (use Recharts).
Implement New Booking Modal with auto-table suggestion logic.
All components must be written in .js (not .tsx) since the environment uses JS files.
Ensure 'data-testid' is on all buttons, links, inputs, and major state containers for robust automated testing.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not apply universal transition (transition: all). Use specific properties.
Do not center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) where appropriate.
Never use emoji characters like 🤖🧠 for icons. Use lucide-react.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, transitions).
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui. Create custom .js components matching style.
NEVER use placeholder image URLs. Use the provided ones.
